verdict.rationale: Workable documents an official, first-party MCP server on its own developer portal. The docs describe it as giving full programmatic access across the hiring lifecycle, from job management and candidate sourcing to offer approvals, and a probe confirmed the page exists. missing for 10: documented connection/setup steps (auth, transport, endpoint URL), supported agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Workable MCP server provides full programmatic access to the Workable recruiting and HR platform. It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
